reviewer.identifier: Codex; Stage 2 whole-Model semantic review against Stage 1 commit 2af856fbf9f542940b66378fa0a04157cc4f1103. Inspected all 20 statements and five arguments, exact propositions, summaries, explanations, definitions, qualifiers, source scopes, dependencies, and the current review packet. Compared the diff and verified that all 16 existing frontmatters are identical except four updated dates and all four existing arguments are byte-identical. Reviewed ARG-005’s full canonical premises and S-004 conclusion before evaluating the two bounded empirical source examples. Checked circularity in reasoning and revision dependencies, the distinction between adoption and confidence, and the unchanged schemas, helpers, and presentation. Findings preserve unresolved empirical burdens; neither this review nor fingerprints certify truth or deductive validity.

src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.proposition: Unchanged S-005 + S-006 + S-009 + S-011 to S-014 practical synthesis under uncertainty.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.qualifiers: Some opportunities and some effects need not overlap in person, state, task, input, or timescale; what if any permits no input.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.evidenceSeparation: Detection, matching, selection, and net-value judgments remain unestablished conditions, not hidden accepted empirical bridges. New adaptability premises supply none.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.alignment: Exact premises and conclusion, verbatim empirical quotations, summary, practical decision principle, and target/safety distinction remain aligned and unchanged.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.inferenceAndImpact: Defeasible strategy is appropriate even if the empirical premises are true. S-006’s consideration rationale is not used as efficacy evidence. The functional-target explanation does not establish the rationale backward or justify inputs without an actionable match.

src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.proposition: Unchanged S-004 + S-005 to S-006 normative scope reasoning.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.qualifiers: Open-ended potential and legitimate aim retain bounded framework/value meanings; the conclusion concerns considering care, not universal benefit or action now.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.evidenceSeparation: ARG-005 adds a rationale for one premise without supplying chiropractic efficacy evidence. Asymptomatic benefit still requires a relevant opportunity, effective input, and net-positive outcomes in matching conditions.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.alignment: Entire argument file preserved. Exact premise meanings, independent-aim bridge, conclusion, and symptom/target boundary remain accurate after the contextual S-004/S-005 edits.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.inferenceAndImpact: Defeasible remains appropriate because the brief premises do not force the scope interpretation and normative bridge. This route is not replaced by ARG-005; it continues into ARG-002 without implying a warranted input.

src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.proposition: Unchanged S-001 + S-002 to S-003 methodological synthesis.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.qualifiers: The premises motivate a revisable method, not its uniqueness or deductive necessity.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.evidenceSeparation: Neither method adoption nor the new biological opening establishes empirical truth.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.alignment: Exact premise/conclusion records, summary, scheme, and prose remain unchanged. The authoring clarification preserves analytical reasoning first.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.inferenceAndImpact: Defeasible remains appropriate. No dependency arrow supplies proof; no new argument changes the methodological route.

src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.proposition: Unchanged S-014 + S-015 to S-016 iterative hypothesis-testing strategy.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.qualifiers: An applied input triggers the sequence; comparisons need the same target and relevant conditions. Further input remains conditional.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.evidenceSeparation: Informative measurements and decision thresholds are not established by the premises; observed changes remain compatible with alternative explanations.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.alignment: Exact premises, conclusion, summary, practical principle, and explanation remain unchanged and aligned with retained assessment/application boundaries.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.inferenceAndImpact: Defeasible because learning and subsequent action require methodological choices and useful observations. The regulatory additions do not validate reassessment or turn no-response findings into reasons for repeated input.

src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.proposition: New S-017 + S-007 + S-018 + S-019 + S-008 + S-020 to S-004 route, resolved against the full canonical propositions and their explanations.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.qualifiers: Maintenance/adaptation, central integration, information limits, contextual mismatch in some circumstances, and reorganization capacity are not strengthened to universal improvement or chiropractic response.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.evidenceSeparation: All six premises remain independently empirical with unresolved confidence. S-004 remains a framework commitment; bounded motor-learning findings do not empirically prove open-ended potential.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.alignment: The named scheme and prose expose the interpretive principle connecting context-responsive function to refusing a health-status completion criterion. Summary and exact S-004 quotation retain the existing meaning. A locally best feasible response and maintenance without improvement are explicit compatible cases.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.inferenceAndImpact: Defeasible, not deductive: the exact premises do not entail a health-status scope conclusion. The framing principle is revisable and supplies no missing empirical better-alternative claim. No S-005/S-009 or downstream benefit premise is used; both dependency and argument participation plus explanatory prose were checked for reverse support. ARG-004 remains intact, and non-overlap, modifiability/benefit, and chiropractic-instantiation gaps remain explicit.

src/content/model/statements/assessment..proposition: Unchanged practical strategy developing a working judgment about present actionable opportunity and what available input, if any, could provide beneficial neuromotor change.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..qualifiers: Presently, can be identified, and what if any preserve fallibility and withholding. Failure to identify an opportunity does not prove its absence.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..evidenceSeparation: Detection, prediction, selection thresholds, and safety procedures remain unvalidated. Adoption of the strategy and the foundation supplies no empirical person-level capability.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..alignment: Entire statement, summary, actionable-opportunity definition, target versus safety distinction, missed-opportunity account, and boundary are preserved.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..inferenceAndImpact: S-005 normative, S-006 conceptual, and S-009/S-011 practical dependencies remain. ARG-002 exposes non-overlap even if empirical premises are true; S-015/S-016 preserve conditional action and reassessment. ARG-005 creates no new reason to intervene.

src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.proposition: Unchanged empirical assertion that some chiropractic-produced neuromotor changes contribute to broader net-positive function.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.qualifiers: Some specifies occurrence without prevalence or universality; broader and net-positive require more than a changed immediate measure.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. Causal transfer, duration, meaningful outcomes, and costs require evidence independent of general learning and beneficial neuromotor effects.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.alignment: Entire statement, summary, benefit explanation, evidence status, and revision conditions are preserved.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 conceptual and S-011 empirical dependencies remain. S-013 is see-also only and supplies no proof of benefit. S-017–S-020 add no causal bridge and this statement is not required for S-014’s local neuromotor selection strategy.

src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.proposition: Unchanged framework scope proposition allowing a rationale for considering care without symptoms, injury, disease, or pathology.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.qualifiers: Non-necessity concerns a rationale, not effectiveness in every symptom-free person or sufficient justification to proceed.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.evidenceSeparation: Neither S-004’s biological rationale nor S-005’s aim establishes asymptomatic efficacy, valid assessment, or an actionable match.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.alignment: The statement, summary, target requirement, safety/comfort distinction, and no-universal-need boundary remain aligned and unchanged.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.inferenceAndImpact: S-004 conceptual and S-005 normative dependencies remain. ARG-004 remains defeasible and unchanged; S-014/ARG-002 independently explain adjustment targets and actionability. Their contextual cross-reference is not a return proof of S-006.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Unchanged conditional practical application of a selected input as an intentional training stimulus to test and act on the working hypothesis.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: When proceeding is warranted governs action; intended describes purpose without asserting successful learning or benefit.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence is separate from adoption. Delivery establishes neither the proposed perturbation nor beneficial response, duration, or appropriate further dosing.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Entire proposition, summary, intentional-use explanation, withholding condition, and protocol deferral remain aligned.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: S-011 and S-014 remain practical dependencies for intended mechanism/response and selection. S-020’s ordinary updating adds no evidence of the selected input’s effectiveness. ARG-003 and S-016 still require an informative check.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Unchanged empirical assertion of beneficial neuromotor changes from some chiropractic inputs through perturbation, distinct from intentional training use.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: Some limits scope without turning occurrence into possibility. Prospective selection and independent outcome criteria prevent post-hoc success definitions.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. New general biological and learning premises do not establish chiropractic instantiation, benefit, or selection validity.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Entire proposition, summary, effect/intention distinction, evidence note, and revision conditions retain their baseline commitment.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 conceptual and S-010 empirical dependencies remain unchanged. S-012/S-013 still require transfer/mediation evidence, and S-014/S-015/ARG-002 require a person-level actionable match. No chiropractic conclusion supports ARG-005.

src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.proposition: Framework rule separating claim kinds, logical validity, premise truth, and evidential strength.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.qualifiers: Deductive evaluations apply where necessity is asserted; adoption and current confidence do not establish soundness.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.evidenceSeparation: The explanation expressly permits adopted empirical claims with unresolved support and uses no editorial status.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.alignment: Unchanged statement, summary, categories, and explanation apply to empirical S-017–S-020 and framework S-004 without mixing their kinds.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.inferenceAndImpact: S-001 remains methodological upstream. S-003 and ARG-001 remain compatible; ARG-005 must be assessed as defeasible framework reasoning, not a proof inferred from empirical statement types.

src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.proposition: Framework method exposing premises, scope, modality, and inference before independently evaluating empirical support.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.qualifiers: Where a conclusion is proposed scopes the method. First describes analytical order, not a ranking of disciplines or all Philosophy pages before Science.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.evidenceSeparation: Empirical findings may revise any premise or inference but do not by themselves establish validity. Unresolved confidence does not weaken a proposition automatically.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.alignment: The unchanged statement, summary, modal examples, and revision discussion agree with the focused authoring-contract clarification and the construction then source-check workflow.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.inferenceAndImpact: S-001/S-002 methodological dependencies and ARG-001 remain intact. Applied the same non-overlap rule to ARG-005 and retained the gaps exposed by ARG-002 and ARG-004.

src/content/model/statements/functional-.proposition: Unchanged framework proposition: Human functional potential is open-ended. Health or symptom status alone does not define completed human function across circumstances.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.qualifiers: Open-ended excludes limitless capacity, inevitable progress, a measurable imperfection in everyone, or an actionable opportunity now. No qualifier was added to the proposition.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains not-applicable for the framework commitment. ARG-005 supplies a defeasible biological rationale with unresolved empirical premises, not experimental confirmation of S-004.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.alignment: Only starting-position language, an ARG-005 explanatory paragraph, and updated date changed. Summary, boundaries, revision condition, and exact proposition retain the baseline meaning.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: ARG-005 does not use S-005, S-009, or downstream benefits. Its failure reopens that argument without necessarily changing S-004’s meaning; no argument edges are copied into revision dependencies. S-005, S-006, and ARG-004 remain appropriate.

src/content/model/statements/information.proposition: New empirical assertion that neural regulation uses available sensory information and prior experience to estimate body and environmental states; supplied wording is retained.
src/content/model/statements/information.qualifiers: Available is not complete or objectively best; sensory scope includes internal/external signals and experience need not be conscious. The account is not all human regulation or one comprehensive model.
src/content/model/statements/information.evidenceSeparation: The cited behavioral study is a bounded example, with tested alternatives and optimality limits explained. Broader scope and implementation remain unresolved; adoption does not confirm the universal account.
src/content/model/statements/information.alignment: Proposition, summary, explanation, source note, and revision conditions preserve the information/experience relationship without equating better function with prediction accuracy.
src/content/model/statements/information.inferenceAndImpact: Independent additional empirical premise, not deduced from S-007. Conceptual dependency to S-020 identifies which estimates update, without establishing updating. ARG-005 uses it without a reverse dependency on S-004 or benefit.

src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.proposition: Unchanged empirical assertion of central nervous-system integration in organizing, coordinating, and regulating human function.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.qualifiers: Central identifies integration within interacting systems, not sole control or biological supremacy. Scope remains human.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.evidenceSeparation: Broad claim-specific appraisal is still undocumented and confidence unresolved. S-017’s organismic claim and S-004’s framework commitment supply no evidence of neural integration.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.alignment: Body now locates the human neural account within organismic organization and expressly treats it as an additional premise. Proposition, summary, whole-person boundary, and revision condition remain unchanged.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.inferenceAndImpact: Independent empirical root; no S-017-to-S-007 or S-004-to-S-007 dependency is manufactured. ARG-005 uses S-007 without deriving it from organisms generally. S-013 still bears its separate chiropractic mediation and primacy burden.

src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.proposition: Unchanged empirical proposal that broader chiropractic effects occur principally through nervous-system-mediated change.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.qualifiers: Principally proposes a main pathway, not exclusive neural control or guaranteed effects from every input. Broader effects need not be net-positive.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.evidenceSeparation: Mediation, primacy, and particular pathways remain distinct unresolved questions; S-007’s contextual edit and the new regulatory foundation settle none.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.alignment: Entire proposition, summary, three empirical questions, evidence status, boundaries, and revision conditions are preserved.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.inferenceAndImpact: S-007/S-011 empirical dependencies and the related-only S-012 pair retain their meaning. Neither general integration nor favorable outcomes establishes mediation or primacy. No downstream claim is fed into ARG-005.

src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.proposition: Unchanged empirical capacity claim that some context-limiting motor strategies can be modified for overall functional improvement.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.qualifiers: Some limits cases, can asserts beneficial modifiability, and context bounds the interpretation. Constraint, opportunity, and actionable target remain distinct.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.evidenceSeparation: Task-specific adaptation evidence does not validate the constraint construct, net-benefit criterion, assessment, or chiropractic responsiveness. Confidence remains unresolved.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.alignment: Entire proposition, summary, constraint and subluxation definitions, evidence, and revision conditions are preserved; beneficial capacity was not weakened to intention or mere uncertainty.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 and S-008 remain conceptual dependencies. ARG-002 still exposes overlap and detection gaps. Because the benefit criterion is informed by S-004, S-009 is deliberately excluded from ARG-005’s justification of S-004; foundational adaptability supplies no proof of S-009.

src/content/model/statements/organismic-.proposition: New empirical biological assertion of active maintenance and adaptation of living organisms’ functional organization, using the supplied proposition verbatim.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.qualifiers: Active describes biological participation, not conscious purpose or infallibility. The explanation permits failure and differing processes/timescales without weakening the characteristic biological assertion.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.evidenceSeparation: Confidence is unresolved because full organism/process/life-stage appraisal is undocumented. The definition supplies no existence evidence and motor-task research does not establish organism-wide scope.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.alignment: Title, summary, brief definition, evidence discussion, and revision conditions agree. Passive persistence and failure are explicit alternatives/tests; no universal healing, improvement, or chiropractic response is asserted.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.inferenceAndImpact: Independent empirical premise in ARG-005. S-007 is separately asserted for humans, not entailed for all organisms. No decorative dependency or inferred neural universality is introduced; downstream benefit claims are not used to establish maintenance.

src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.proposition: Framework commitment assigning connected philosophical, scientific, and practical roles within a revisable account.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.qualifiers: Contextual application and best-supported understanding describe the method, not a guarantee that practice is validated.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.evidenceSeparation: Stephenson and Strauss remain historical provenance, not empirical authority. Inclusion does not establish premise truth.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.alignment: Unchanged proposition, summary, triad explanation, historical notes, and authorship agree. The new organismic opening is compatible with analytical reasoning first.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.inferenceAndImpact: S-002 and S-003 retain methodological dependencies and ARG-001 retains its defeasible synthesis. Choosing a biological introduction does not convert philosophy into empirical evidence or display order into inference.

src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.proposition: Unchanged value commitment adopting net-positive functional improvement as a legitimate chiropractic aim.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.qualifiers: A legitimate aim need not be exclusive. Net-positive retains person, goals, burdens, harms, tradeoffs, and timescale rather than equating change with benefit.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.evidenceSeparation: The contextual edit expressly says S-004 frames possibilities without establishing improvement in a particular case. Confidence stays not-applicable; value does not establish efficacy.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.alignment: Proposition, summary, benefit criterion, symptom/success boundary, and definitions are preserved. Only the sentence describing S-004 and the date changed.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.inferenceAndImpact: S-004 remains conceptual upstream. S-006, S-009, S-011, S-012, S-014, ARG-002, and ARG-004 retain their distinct uses of the criterion. S-005 supplies no reverse justification to ARG-005.

src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.proposition: Unchanged practical strategy repeating assessment after input to test the hypothesis and guide stopping, revision, or a justified different input.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.qualifiers: Following input scopes the trigger; when justified preserves conditional follow-up. An unchanged finding never makes further input obligatory.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.evidenceSeparation: Observed change remains compatible with natural variability, repeated testing, expectation, and error. Confidence and reassessment validity remain unresolved.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.alignment: Entire proposition, summary, explanation, stopping options, and boundary preserve the distinction between testing and causal proof.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.inferenceAndImpact: S-014/S-015 practical dependencies and ARG-003 remain appropriate. Next-cycle feedback is not used as a same-cycle proof or dependency. New regulatory premises neither validate reassessment nor guarantee useful learning from it.

src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.proposition: New empirical assertion of incomplete information, biological response constraints, and competing demands in neural regulation, with supplied wording unchanged.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.qualifiers: Incomplete information concerns estimation; biological constraints concern feasible responses; competing demands concern priorities/tradeoffs. The explanation does not make every constraint sensory uncertainty.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.evidenceSeparation: Full combined appraisal is missing and confidence unresolved. Limited examples do not establish all components; comparisons must distinguish the proposed limits from alternative priorities or measurement error.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.alignment: Summary, three-part explanation, boundaries, and concrete revision conditions remain aligned with the asserted limits. Accurate estimates can coexist with unavailable responses or unavoidable tradeoffs.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.inferenceAndImpact: Independent premise in ARG-005, with no incoming decorative argument. Neither S-008’s mismatch nor S-009’s beneficial modification is deduced from limitations. No claim of a better accessible strategy or benefit now is added.

src/content/model/statements/salient-per.proposition: Unchanged empirical mechanism hypothesis asserting capacity of sufficiently salient neurobiomechanical perturbation to prompt strategy reevaluation and reorganization.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.qualifiers: Can asserts capacity, not certainty. Salience must be defined prospectively, independently of success; change need not be beneficial.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.evidenceSeparation: Confidence and current-evidence status remain unresolved. S-020’s task example is not promoted into a claim-specific appraisal of this trigger or chiropractic instantiation.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.alignment: Added only an introductory distinction from ordinary sensory updating and updated the date. Exact proposition, summary, perturbation definition, boundary, and falsifiable revision conditions are unchanged.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.inferenceAndImpact: S-008 remains conceptual upstream and S-011 remains empirically dependent on this mechanism. The related pair stored on S-020 supports comparison only; no new dependency claims that ordinary updating establishes salience, the specific mechanism, or beneficial effect.

src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.proposition: New empirical assertion of sensory estimate updating together with capacity for new sensory information to contribute to neuromotor strategy reorganization; supplied wording retained.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.qualifiers: Can lead asserts capacity, not uncertainty alone or response to every signal. Updating an estimate and changing coordination are distinguished; retention does not establish benefit.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.evidenceSeparation: The adaptation example does not isolate sensory novelty or directly measure state estimates. Its task-specific support leaves the combined claim unresolved and supplies no chiropractic effect evidence.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.alignment: Summary, S-008 definitions, evidence limits, and separate tests of updating versus strategy change align. Neither universal predictive processing nor global optimization is asserted; the compound record creates no independently needed argument conclusion.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-018/S-008 dependencies have specific limiting notes, with no transitive duplication. S-010 is related only, retaining separate trigger and salience burdens. ARG-005 uses the capacity without upgrading it to feasible beneficial modification or importing S-009/S-011.

src/content/model/statements/state-depen.proposition: Unchanged empirical account of state-, task-, and environment-dependent neuromotor function, including limited or poorly suited strategies in some circumstances.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.qualifiers: In some circumstances limits occurrence; variation, restricted options, or stiffness alone does not establish a constraint worth changing.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.evidenceSeparation: Existing standing-threat and pointing sources retain their narrow scope. Confidence remains unresolved; new regulatory premises establish neither mismatch in every person nor beneficial modifiability.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.alignment: Entire file preserved, including summary, neuromotor and motor-strategy definitions, measurement alternatives, evidence notes, and revision conditions. No split or competing restatement is needed.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.inferenceAndImpact: Existing conceptual dependencies to S-009 and S-010 remain. New conceptual dependency to S-020 reuses definitions without proving reorganization. ARG-005 uses the exact context/mismatch claim without assuming an accessible better strategy; no S-004-derived premise returns upstream.
